description: Measured baseline for the performance-budget regression tests (tests/perf-budget-chats-baseline.test.js). Synthetic fixtures, median of 3 runs, event loop sampled at 1 ms. Threshold in CI = min(p95Ms * 1.2, absolute ceiling).

schema.backend: string, storage backend the number was measured on ('json')
schema.chats: number of synthetic chats in the fixture
schema.samples: total samples behind the quantiles (per-run n * 3 runs; quantiles are the median across runs)
schema.bytesWritten: optional: bytes of the document rewritten per change
schema.eventLoopResolutionMs: monitorEventLoopDelay resolution during capture; must be <= 1
